description: Model registry — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for tag -> model_id AND pricing. A `tag` is the short alias used across local files and the plugin (agent `.md` frontmatter `model: <tag>`); `model_id` is the real Claude model string, used both to invoke the model and for telemetry. `pricing` (USD per MTok: input/cached_input/output) is authoritative for telemetry cost accounting — the pipeline reads it from here, never restates rates elsewhere. `cache_write_multipliers` price prompt-cache CREATION relative to the model's input rate (Anthropic standard: 5-minute TTL = 1.25x, 1-hour TTL = 2x); the usage tool multiplies the per-turn ephemeral_5m/ephemeral_1h cache-creation token split by these. To bump a model or its price, edit it HERE (README/CORE-TODO/SKILL link here). `pipeline_tiers` lists the tags the pipeline actually dispatches and that hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh enforces (mirror of its is_valid_tier list — keep in sync); the remaining `models` entries are reference/pin-only.

estimation_baselines._comment: Per-dispatch token baselines for the Step 1d-1 dry-run cost preview ONLY — never for billing or the cost cap, which use transcript-derived actuals (ADR-0005/0011). Derived from the median of 56 transcript-priced phases across 10 real runs, excluding `development` (see its phase multiplier in SKILL.md 1d-1). Note the shape: uncached `input` is negligible while `cache_read` dominates — a phase is a multi-turn agent loop that re-reads its whole prefix every turn, which the pre-2026-07 baseline (35k input, 60% cached, single call) did not model at all and so under-reported real cost by 6-10x. Priced with the same formula as usage.mjs priceUsage, including cache_write_multipliers. Re-derive when the agent roster or prompt sizes change materially.
estimation_baselines._fable_note: No fable run has been measured; it inherits the opus token shape and is priced at its own registry rates.
